dir=\"auto\"\u003e\n\u003cli\u003eHooks v2 is now generally available, with support for loading hooks from installed plugins. (\u003ca href=\"https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5307\" data-hovercard-type=\"pull_request\" data-hovercard-url=\"/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5307/hovercard\"\u003e#5307\u003c/a\u003e, \u003ca href=\"https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5198\" data-hovercard-type=\"pull_request\" data-hovercard-url=\"/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5198/hovercard\"\u003e#5198\u003c/a\u003e)\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003eAuto approval classifier configuration now supports selecting the classifier model and setting a review timeout. (\u003ca href=\"https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5205\" data-hovercard-type=\"pull_request\" data-hovercard-url=\"/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5205/hovercard\"\u003e#5205\u003c/a\u003e, \u003ca href=\"https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5302\" data-hovercard-type=\"pull_request\" data-hovercard-url=\"/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5302/hovercard\"\u003e#5302\u003c/a\u003e)\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003eHITL rejection reasons are now framed for the model, and the approval menu makes reject-with-feedback easier to discover. (\u003ca href=\"https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5259\" data-hovercard-type=\"pull_request\" data-hovercard-url=\"/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5259/hovercard\"\u003e#5259\u003c/a\u003e, \u003ca href=\"https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5260\" data-hovercard-type=\"pull_request\" data-hovercard-url=\"/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5260/hovercard\"\u003e#5260\u003c/a\u003e)\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003eAdded a tri-state \u003ccode\u003eDEEPAGENTS_CODE_ONBOARDING\u003c/code\u003e environment variable. (\u003ca href=\"https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5301\" data-hovercard-type=\"pull_request\" data-hovercard-url=\"/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5301/hovercard\"\u003e#5301\u003c/a\u003e)\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003eThe \u003ccode\u003e/model\u003c/code\u003e footer Ctrl+N hint now follows the current display mode. (\u003ca href=\"https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5247\" data-hovercard-type=\"pull_request\" data-hovercard-url=\"/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5247/hovercard\"\u003e#5247\u003c/a\u003e)\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003eThe price catalog now refreshes hourly in the background. (\u003ca href=\"https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5264\" data-hovercard-type=\"pull_request\" data-hovercard-url=\"/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5264/hovercard\"\u003e#5264\u003c/a\u003e)\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003eUpdated recommendations to include DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731. markdownlint-disable MD024 --\u003e","","# Deep Agents Code Changelog","","## [0.1.69](https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/compare/deepagents-code==0.1.68...deepagents-code==0.1.69) (2026-09-14)","","### Features","","- Update `read_file` output formatting. ([#5648](https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5648))","- Surface DeepSeek V4.1 Flash in the model picker. ([#6254](https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/6254))","- Surface locally tracked GitHub stacks in agent context. ([#6290](https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/6290))","- Copy a model slug with Ctrl+click. ([#6243](https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/6243))","- Show session length in the Debug Console. ([#6224](https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/6224))","","### Bug Fixes","","- Price nested usage with its own model and honor completions. ([#6251](https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/6251))","- Drop stale Anthropic thinking blocks. ([#6300](https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/6300))","- Isolate credentials used for user shell tracing. ([#6242](https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/6242))","- Attribute dotenv configuration sources. ([#6222](https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/6222))","- Expose unknown reasoning effort values. ([#6241](https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/6241))","- Open the Debug Console at the bottom of the log. ([#6218](https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/6218))","- Order Debug Console log filters. ([#6217](https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/6217))","- Show the spinner during pre-stream turn setup. ([#6253](https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/6253))","- Demote no-output hint suppression messages to debug logging. ([#6245](https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/6245))","","## [0.1.68](https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/compare/deepagents-code==0.1.67...deepagents-code==0.1.68) (2026-09-10)","","### Features","","- Recommended GLM 5.3 models are now available in code workflows ([#6211](https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/6211)).","","### Bug Fixes","","- Added pricing support for Fireworks GLM-5.3 and GLM-5.3 Flash usage ([#6221](https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/6221), [#6223](https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/6223)).","- Workspace switches now ask for confirmation before restarting the server ([#6178](https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/6178)).","- Effort changes are now included in cache identity for OpenAI and Anthropic requests ([#6196](https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/6196)).","- Standardized the recent-thread environment variable ([#6205](https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/6205)).","- Silenced warnings when the themes config is absent ([#6220](https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/6220)).","","## [0.1.67](https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/compare/deepagents-code==0.1.66...deepagents-code==0.1.67) (2026-09-09)","","### Features","","- Added `GPT-6 Astra` support ([#6141](https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/6141)).","- Reuses the server across workspace switches ([#6152](https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/6152)).","- Limits thread resume age ([#6068](https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/6068)).","","### Bug Fixes","","- Improved workspace isolation by resolving project policy per workspace, scoping project dotenv to workspaces, and isolating LangSmith auth and workspace tracing ([#6064](https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/6064), [#5980](https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5980), [#6061](https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/6061)).","- Improved transcript tail reconciliation by bounding and serializing reconciliation work ([#6057](https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/6057), [#6143](https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/6143)).","- Refuses a second sandbox workspace and moves sandbox creation and entry off the guarded event loop ([#5979](https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5979), [#6017](https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/6017)).","- Surfaces stale updates in-session ([#6063](https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/6063)).","- Surfaces the LangSmith credential in `dcode config` ([#6083](https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/6083)).","- Offloads server config imports ([#6089](https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/6089)).","- Correctly parses extra skill directories with the platform separator ([#6151](https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/6151)).","","## [0.1.66](https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/compare/deepagents-code==0.1.65...deepagents-code==0.1.66) (2026-09-03)","","### Features","","- Defaulted general-purpose subagents to fork mode ([#6024](https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/6024)).","- Defaulted the Auto classifier by provider ([#6039](https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/6039)).","- Added support for binding conversations to a recorded workspace ([#5946](https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5946)).","- Added tracing for the effective approval mode ([#5972](https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5972)).","","### Bug Fixes","","- Fixed request-time working directory binding and now show the bound workspace in shell approvals ([#5968](https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5968), [#5966](https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5966)).","- Fixed marketplace plugin installs to accept bare relative source paths and identify the rejected source path when validation fails ([#5959](https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5959), [#5960](https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5960)).","- Classifier errors now include model names ([#6038](https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/6038)).","- Updated the splash screen to use a sharp border ([#5970](https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5970)).","","### Performance Improvements","","- Reduced QuickJS middleware tracing overhead by omitting trace inputs ([#6015](https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/6015)).","","## [0.1.65](https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/compare/deepagents-code==0.1.64...deepagents-code==0.1.65) (2026-08-28)","","### Features","","- Added Python extension support, including discovery, configuration and loading, runtime hosting, and trust and inspection UX ([#5631](https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5631), [#5632](https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5632), [#5633](https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5633), [#5634](https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5634))","- Added a `/summarization-model` command and model picker for configuring the summarization model ([#5884](https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5884), [#5932](https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5932))","- Added support for optional extra uninstall commands ([#5875](https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5875))","- Added an option to show visible reasoning ([#5887](https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5887))","","### Bug Fixes","","- Improved model and task reliability by retrying interrupted model streams, recovering stale pending work before compaction, and isolating parallel `task` failures ([#5905](https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5905), [#5909](https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5909), [#5954](https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5954))","- Improved server restart handling by waiting for graph readiness before continuing ([#5947](https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5947))","- Capped MCP tool names for provider compatibility ([#5953](https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5953))","- Fixed Auto approval gate path expansion handling and now records Auto classifier deadline misses as traced errors ([#5941](https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5941), [#5944](https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5944))","- Completed ASCII UI fallbacks and hid inactive F2 tool hints ([#5930](https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5930), [#5939](https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5939))","- Isolated debug logs by thread ([#5921](https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5921))","- Updated rubric grader model changes to apply without a restart ([#5885](https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5885))","","## [0.1.64](https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/compare/deepagents-code==0.1.63...deepagents-code==0.1.64) (2026-08-28)","","### Features","","- Added trace metadata attribution for skill invocations ([#5925](https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5925)).","- Added a list of MCP servers that require login ([#5867](https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5867)).","- Added the ability to copy the current model from the picker header ([#5904](https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5904)).","- Linked the doctor commit hash to GitHub ([#5920](https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5920)).","- Standardized the external editor shortcut ([#5911](https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5911)).","","### Bug Fixes","","- Deferred recursion-limit handling to the LangGraph server ([#5882](https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5882)).","- Disabled Git terminal prompts in `execute` ([#5878](https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5878)).","- Improved privacy and debug-only visibility for MCP token and editable paths ([#5866](https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5866), <div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto"><a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/compare/deepagents-code==0.1.68...deepagents-code==0.1.69">0.1.69</a> (2026-09-14)</h2><a id="user-content-0169-2026-09-14" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: 0.1.69 (2026-09-14)" href="#0169-2026-09-14"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Features</h3><a id="user-content-features" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Features" href="#features"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Update <code>read_file</code> output formatting. (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5648" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5648/hovercard">#5648</a>)</li>
<li>Surface DeepSeek V4.1 Flash in the model picker. (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/6254" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/6254/hovercard">#6254</a>)</li>
<li>Surface locally tracked GitHub stacks in agent context. (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/6290" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/6290/hovercard">#6290</a>)</li>
<li>Copy a model slug with Ctrl+click. (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/6243" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/6243/hovercard">#6243</a>)</li>
<li>Show session length in the Debug Console. (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/6224" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/6224/hovercard">#6224</a>)</li>
</ul>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Bug Fixes</h3><a id="user-content-bug-fixes" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Bug Fixes" href="#bug-fixes"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Price nested usage with its own model and honor completions. (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/6251" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/6251/hovercard">#6251</a>)</li>
<li>Drop stale Anthropic thinking blocks. (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/6300" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/6300/hovercard">#6300</a>)</li>
<li>Isolate credentials used for user shell tracing. (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/6242" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/6242/hovercard">#6242</a>)</li>
<li>Attribute dotenv configuration sources. (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/6222" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/6222/hovercard">#6222</a>)</li>
<li>Expose unknown reasoning effort values. (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/6241" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/6241/hovercard">#6241</a>)</li>
<li>Open the Debug Console at the bottom of the log. (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/6218" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/6218/hovercard">#6218</a>)</li>
<li>Order Debug Console log filters. (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/6217" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/6217/hovercard">#6217</a>)</li>
<li>Show the spinner during pre-stream turn setup. (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/6253" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/6253/hovercard">#6253</a>)</li>
<li>Demote no-output hint suppression messages to debug logging. (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/6245" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/6245/hovercard">#6245</a>)</li>
</ul>

<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Features</h3><a id="user-content-features-1" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Features" href="#features-1"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Recommended GLM 5.3 models are now available in code workflows (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/6211" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/6211/hovercard">#6211</a>).</li>
</ul>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Bug Fixes</h3><a id="user-content-bug-fixes-1" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Bug Fixes" href="#bug-fixes-1"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Added pricing support for Fireworks GLM-5.3 and GLM-5.3 Flash usage (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/6221" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/6221/hovercard">#6221</a>, <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/6223" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/6223/hovercard">#6223</a>).</li>
<li>Workspace switches now ask for confirmation before restarting the server (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/6178" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/6178/hovercard">#6178</a>).</li>
<li>Effort changes are now included in cache identity for OpenAI and Anthropic requests (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/6196" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/6196/hovercard">#6196</a>).</li>
<li>Standardized the recent-thread environment variable (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/6205" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/6205/hovercard">#6205</a>).</li>
<li>Silenced warnings when the themes config is absent (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/6220" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/6220/hovercard">#6220</a>).</li>
</ul>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto"><a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/compare/deepagents-code==0.1.66...deepagents-code==0.1.67">0.1.67</a> (2026-09-09)</h2><a id="user-content-0167-2026-09-09" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: 0.1.67 (2026-09-09)" href="#0167-2026-09-09"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Features</h3><a id="user-content-features-2" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Features" href="#features-2"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Added <code>GPT-6 Astra</code> support (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/6141" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/6141/hovercard">#6141</a>).</li>
<li>Reuses the server across workspace switches (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/6152" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/6152/hovercard">#6152</a>).</li>
<li>Limits thread resume age (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/6068" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/6068/hovercard">#6068</a>).</li>
</ul>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Bug Fixes</h3><a id="user-content-bug-fixes-2" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Bug Fixes" href="#bug-fixes-2"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Improved workspace isolation by resolving project policy per workspace, scoping project dotenv to workspaces, and isolating LangSmith auth and workspace tracing (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/6064" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/6064/hovercard">#6064</a>, <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5980" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5980/hovercard">#5980</a>, <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/6061" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/6061/hovercard">#6061</a>).</li>
<li>Improved transcript tail reconciliation by bounding and serializing reconciliation work (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/6057" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/6057/hovercard">#6057</a>, <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/6143" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/6143/hovercard">#6143</a>).</li>
<li>Refuses a second sandbox workspace and moves sandbox creation and entry off the guarded event loop (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5979" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5979/hovercard">#5979</a>, <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/6017" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/6017/hovercard">#6017</a>).</li>
<li>Surfaces stale updates in-session (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/6063" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/6063/hovercard">#6063</a>).</li>
<li>Surfaces the LangSmith credential in <code>dcode config</code> (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/6083" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/6083/hovercard">#6083</a>).</li>
<li>Offloads server config imports (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/6089" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/6089/hovercard">#6089</a>).</li>
<li>Correctly parses extra skill directories with the platform separator (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/6151" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/6151/hovercard">#6151</a>).</li>
</ul>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto"><a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/compare/deepagents-code==0.1.65...deepagents-code==0.1.66">0.1.66</a> (2026-09-03)</h2><a id="user-content-0166-2026-09-03" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: 0.1.66 (2026-09-03)" href="#0166-2026-09-03"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Features</h3><a id="user-content-features-3" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Features" href="#features-3"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Defaulted general-purpose subagents to fork mode (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/6024" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/6024/hovercard">#6024</a>).</li>
<li>Defaulted the Auto classifier by provider (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/6039" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/6039/hovercard">#6039</a>).</li>
<li>Added support for binding conversations to a recorded workspace (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5946" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5946/hovercard">#5946</a>).</li>
<li>Added tracing for the effective approval mode (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5972" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5972/hovercard">#5972</a>).</li>
</ul>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Bug Fixes</h3><a id="user-content-bug-fixes-3" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Bug Fixes" href="#bug-fixes-3"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Fixed request-time working directory binding and now show the bound workspace in shell approvals (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5968" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5968/hovercard">#5968</a>, <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5966" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5966/hovercard">#5966</a>).</li>
<li>Fixed marketplace plugin installs to accept bare relative source paths and identify the rejected source path when validation fails (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5959" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5959/hovercard">#5959</a>, <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5960" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5960/hovercard">#5960</a>).</li>
<li>Classifier errors now include model names (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/6038" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/6038/hovercard">#6038</a>).</li>
<li>Updated the splash screen to use a sharp border (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5970" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5970/hovercard">#5970</a>).</li>
</ul>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Performance Improvements</h3><a id="user-content-performance-improvements" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Performance Improvements" href="#performance-improvements"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Reduced QuickJS middleware tracing overhead by omitting trace inputs (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/6015" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/6015/hovercard">#6015</a>).</li>
</ul>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto"><a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/compare/deepagents-code==0.1.64...deepagents-code==0.1.65">0.1.65</a> (2026-08-28)</h2><a id="user-content-0165-2026-08-28" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: 0.1.65 (2026-08-28)" href="#0165-2026-08-28"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Features</h3><a id="user-content-features-4" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Features" href="#features-4"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Added Python extension support, including discovery, configuration and loading, runtime hosting, and trust and inspection UX (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5631" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5631/hovercard">#5631</a>, <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5632" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5632/hovercard">#5632</a>, <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5633" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5633/hovercard">#5633</a>, <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5634" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5634/hovercard">#5634</a>)</li>
<li>Added a <code>/summarization-model</code> command and model picker for configuring the summarization model (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5884" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5884/hovercard">#5884</a>, <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5932" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5932/hovercard">#5932</a>)</li>
<li>Added support for optional extra uninstall commands (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5875" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5875/hovercard">#5875</a>)</li>
<li>Added an option to show visible reasoning (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5887" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5887/hovercard">#5887</a>)</li>
</ul>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Bug Fixes</h3><a id="user-content-bug-fixes-4" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Bug Fixes" href="#bug-fixes-4"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Improved model and task reliability by retrying interrupted model streams, recovering stale pending work before compaction, and isolating parallel <code>task</code> failures (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5905" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5905/hovercard">#5905</a>, <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5909" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5909/hovercard">#5909</a>, <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5954" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5954/hovercard">#5954</a>)</li>
<li>Improved server restart handling by waiting for graph readiness before continuing (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5947" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5947/hovercard">#5947</a>)</li>
<li>Capped MCP tool names for provider compatibility (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5953" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5953/hovercard">#5953</a>)</li>
<li>Fixed Auto approval gate path expansion handling and now records Auto classifier deadline misses as traced errors (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5941" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5941/hovercard">#5941</a>, <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5944" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5944/hovercard">#5944</a>)</li>
<li>Completed ASCII UI fallbacks and hid inactive F2 tool hints (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5930" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5930/hovercard">#5930</a>, <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5939" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5939/hovercard">#5939</a>)</li>
<li>Isolated debug logs by thread (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5921" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5921/hovercard">#5921</a>)</li>
<li>Updated rubric grader model changes to apply without a restart (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5885" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5885/hovercard">#5885</a>)</li>
</ul>

<ul dir="auto">
<li>Added trace metadata attribution for skill invocations (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5925" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5925/hovercard">#5925</a>).</li>
<li>Added a list of MCP servers that require login (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5867" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5867/hovercard">#5867</a>).</li>
<li>Added the ability to copy the current model from the picker header (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5904" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5904/hovercard">#5904</a>).</li>
<li>Linked the doctor commit hash to GitHub (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5920" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5920/hovercard">#5920</a>).</li>
<li>Standardized the external editor shortcut (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5911" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5911/hovercard">#5911</a>).</li>
</ul>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Bug Fixes</h3><a id="user-content-bug-fixes-5" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Bug Fixes" href="#bug-fixes-5"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Deferred recursion-limit handling to the LangGraph server (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5882" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5882/hovercard">#5882</a>).</li>
<li>Disabled Git terminal prompts in <code>execute</code> (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5878" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5878/hovercard">#5878</a>).</li>
<li>Improved privacy and debug-only visibility for MCP token and editable paths (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5866" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5866/hovercard">#5866</a>, <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5850" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5850/hovercard">#5850</a>).</li>
<li>Updated the model-switch warning to point to <code>/offload</code> (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5901" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5901/hovercard">#5901</a>).</li>
<li>Rejected stale successful updates (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5847" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5847/hovercard">#5847</a>).</li>
<li>Fixed thread timestamp rendering on systems without the glibc-only <code>%-I</code> <code>strftime</code> flag (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5886" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5886/hovercard">#5886</a>).</li>
<li>Respected ASCII mode in the splash border (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5923" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5923/hovercard">#5923</a>).</li>
<li>Skipped unchanged config writes (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5919" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5919/hovercard">#5919</a>).</li>
<li>Skipped uncorrelated-result warnings for auto-mode policy denials (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5869" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5869/hovercard">#5869</a>).</li>
</ul>
