<ul dir="auto">
<li>Added Baseten <code>zai-org/GLM-5.3-Flash</code> to the model switcher (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5844" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5844/hovercard">#5844</a>).</li>
<li>Added support for loading managed config from a remote source (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5776" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5776/hovercard">#5776</a>).</li>
<li>Added retry middleware for transient model errors in model nodes (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4569" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4569/hovercard">#4569</a>).</li>
</ul>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Fixes</h3><a id="user-content-fixes" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Fixes" href="#fixes"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Fixed live cost tracking for dynamic subagents (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5833" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5833/hovercard">#5833</a>).</li>
<li>Improved <code>clear</code> command descriptions (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5841" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5841/hovercard">#5841</a>).</li>
<li>Allowed instrumental Auto actions (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5832" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5832/hovercard">#5832</a>).</li>
<li>Ensured traces are flushed before server shutdown (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5837" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5837/hovercard">#5837</a>).</li>
<li>Made the debug log path click-to-copy (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5845" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5845/hovercard">#5845</a>).</li>
</ul>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto"><a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/compare/deepagents-code==0.1.61...deepagents-code==0.1.62">0.1.62</a> (2026-08-26)</h2><a id="user-content-0162-2026-08-26" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: 0.1.62 (2026-08-26)" href="#0162-2026-08-26"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Features</h3><a id="user-content-features-7" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Features" href="#features-7"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Added <code>/context-doctor</code> for inspecting and troubleshooting context issues (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5830" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5830/hovercard">#5830</a>).</li>
<li>Added warning when switching models mid-session (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5829" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5829/hovercard">#5829</a>).</li>
<li>Added support for <code>DEEPAGENTS_HOME</code> (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5773" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5773/hovercard">#5773</a>).</li>
<li>(Re-)Enabled secret redaction by default (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5816" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5816/hovercard">#5816</a>).</li>
<li>Improved update visibility by showing cached updates in version output (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5817" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5817/hovercard">#5817</a>).</li>
<li>Improved prompts and pickers: the stale editable-deps prompt now defaults to <code>Refresh environment now</code>, and the model picker shows an Escape hint (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5810" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5810/hovercard">#5810</a>, <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5775" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5775/hovercard">#5775</a>).</li>
<li>Added CLI config provider support (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5774" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5774/hovercard">#5774</a>).</li>
</ul>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Bug Fixes</h3><a id="user-content-bug-fixes-6" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Bug Fixes" href="#bug-fixes-6"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Fixed refreshed local context handling after compaction to reduce cache busts (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5828" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5828/hovercard">#5828</a>).</li>
<li>Preserved goal notice history for prompt caching (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5823" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5823/hovercard">#5823</a>).</li>
<li>Improved rubric coverage checks (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5369" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5369/hovercard">#5369</a>).</li>
<li>Protected the TUI from native stderr writes (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5813" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5813/hovercard">#5813</a>).</li>
<li>Fixed Git origin resolution from worktree common Git directories (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5818" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5818/hovercard">#5818</a>).</li>
<li>Fixed prompt clipboard behavior so Tab inserts instead of pages (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5820" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5820/hovercard">#5820</a>).</li>
</ul>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Performance Improvements</h3><a id="user-content-performance-improvements-1" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Performance Improvements" href="#performance-improvements-1"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Reduced tracing overhead by omitting middleware trace inputs (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5815" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5815/hovercard">#5815</a>).</li>
</ul>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto"><a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/compare/deepagents-code==0.1.60...deepagents-code==0.1.61">0.1.61</a> (2026-08-24)</h2><a id="user-content-0161-2026-08-24" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: 0.1.61 (2026-08-24)" href="#0161-2026-08-24"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Features</h3><a id="user-content-features-8" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Features" href="#features-8"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Added <code>google_anthropic_vertex</code> provider support for Claude on Vertex AI (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5760" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5760/hovercard">#5760</a>).</li>
<li>Enforced configured model allowlists (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5649" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5649/hovercard">#5649</a>).</li>
<li>Injected goal and rubric context directly, replacing <code>get_goal</code> and <code>get_rubric</code> (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5041" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5041/hovercard">#5041</a>).</li>
<li>Made <code>/offload</code> server-owned (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5261" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5261/hovercard">#5261</a>).</li>
<li>Added prompt clipboard support (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5733" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5733/hovercard">#5733</a>).</li>
<li>Show Auto approval review progress (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5729" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5729/hovercard">#5729</a>).</li>
</ul>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Bug Fixes</h3><a id="user-content-bug-fixes-7" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Bug Fixes" href="#bug-fixes-7"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Kept long thread resumes responsive (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5772" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5772/hovercard">#5772</a>).</li>
<li>Render first streamed text immediately (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5761" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5761/hovercard">#5761</a>).</li>
<li>Show the incognito shell command widget (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5768" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5768/hovercard">#5768</a>).</li>
<li>Only highlight actionable tool rows (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5769" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5769/hovercard">#5769</a>).</li>
<li>Warn and ignore <code>--auto-approve</code> and <code>--yolo</code> in headless mode (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5750" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5750/hovercard">#5750</a>).</li>
<li>Sweep expired history archives at startup (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5751" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5751/hovercard">#5751</a>).</li>
<li>Clarified auth environment setup (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5767" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5767/hovercard">#5767</a>).</li>
</ul>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto"><a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/compare/deepagents-code==0.1.59...deepagents-code==0.1.60">0.1.60</a> (2026-08-23)</h2><a id="user-content-0160-2026-08-23" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: 0.1.60 (2026-08-23)" href="#0160-2026-08-23"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Features</h3><a id="user-content-features-9" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Features" href="#features-9"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Added <code>editable</code> trace metadata (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5737" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5737/hovercard">#5737</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/commit/23b83ad50f63d241d0069a3dc426d43b211adf2e">23b83ad</a>).</li>
<li>Added shell command highlighting in the chat input (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5675" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5675/hovercard">#5675</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/commit/d711bc61300090181dc89e3e116e8b343fb65425">d711bc6</a>).</li>
<li>Made project <code>.env</code> loading configurable (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5726" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5726/hovercard">#5726</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/commit/995cad67519af294851282133f8c40f643807c88">995cad6</a>).</li>
<li>Unified notification center and settings (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5698" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5698/hovercard">#5698</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/commit/9767f420c622a31a7511c4601739534ddc6062a7">9767f42</a>).</li>
</ul>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Bug Fixes</h3><a id="user-content-bug-fixes-8" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Bug Fixes" href="#bug-fixes-8"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Blocked dotenv git config injection keys (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5723" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5723/hovercard">#5723</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/commit/328f9160e0f95a459be8ad57f76e7178b24a3ef8">328f916</a>).</li>
<li>Persisted Auto approval mode between sessions and simplified Auto fallback copy (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5665" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5665/hovercard">#5665</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/commit/3ac059e1574963fe216692642aa1b1a4044daaa9">3ac059e</a>), (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5670" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5670/hovercard">#5670</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/commit/42afcded97029070f393232778c84aaf3b69fb1c">42afcde</a>).</li>
<li>Fixed recognition of in-flight trace messages (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5738" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5738/hovercard">#5738</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/commit/f1d1f632812a85646d25ac2f3d2d7f39b65a0b49">f1d1f63</a>).</li>
<li>Increased the warm limit to 800 (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5728" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5728/hovercard">#5728</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/commit/f954cde37f1171adc2ec3f1516a0393bded47e82">f954cde</a>).</li>
<li>Improved text selection by supporting <code>Shift</code> + <code>click</code> to extend selections (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5732" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5732/hovercard">#5732</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/commit/e05931b3016ed3d1500df0c5b77402f457ee5686">e05931b</a>).</li>
<li>Polished notification settings by removing expand flicker and the trailing disclosure glyph (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5734" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5734/hovercard">#5734</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/commit/5397812ad5f217cd84f871f121cf9ea8f3d63f4f">5397812</a>).</li>
<li>Improved authentication footers with contextual actions (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5690" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5690/hovercard">#5690</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/commit/074a5019e1f3edfd589614774958400d051e5fe1">074a501</a>).</li>
<li>Standardized modal navigation hints (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5699" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5699/hovercard">#5699</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/commit/85c6833734a547e968221c1199a769d7aac69430">85c6833</a>).</li>
<li>Aligned wrapped debug snapshot values (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5727" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5727/hovercard">#5727</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/commit/1f7495949232fe2e3e3328b6ff9054c202002f95">1f74959</a>).</li>
</ul>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto"><a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/compare/deepagents-code==0.1.58...deepagents-code==0.1.59">0.1.59</a> (2026-08-20)</h2><a id="user-content-0159-2026-08-20" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: 0.1.59 (2026-08-20)" href="#0159-2026-08-20"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Features</h3><a id="user-content-features-10" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Features" href="#features-10"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Added support for <code>managed_config.toml</code> configuration (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5604" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5604/hovercard">#5604</a>)</li>
<li>Multi-select <code>ask_user</code> answers are now encoded as JSON arrays (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5660" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5660/hovercard">#5660</a>)</li>
<li>Made teardown usage stats configurable (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5696" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5696/hovercard">#5696</a>)</li>
<li>Footer pickers now open on click (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5674" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5674/hovercard">#5674</a>)</li>
<li>Replaced Gemini 3.6 Flash with Gemini 3.7 Flash (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5681" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5681/hovercard">#5681</a>)</li>
</ul>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Bug fixes</h3><a id="user-content-bug-fixes-9" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Bug fixes" href="#bug-fixes-9"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Made tool argument validation errors recoverable (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5659" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5659/hovercard">#5659</a>)</li>
<li>Improved streaming performance for tool-call arguments to run in linear time (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5712" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5712/hovercard">#5712</a>)</li>
<li>Fixed durable-mask config resolution with ranked resolver behavior (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5672" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5672/hovercard">#5672</a>)</li>
<li>Skipped background sync in Apple Terminal (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5666" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5666/hovercard">#5666</a>)</li>
<li>Hid thread IDs when tracing is disabled (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5692" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5692/hovercard">#5692</a>)</li>
<li>Kept installed providers visible in <code>/auth</code> (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5689" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5689/hovercard">#5689</a>)</li>
<li>Preloaded the auth UI before notification handoff (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5697" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5697/hovercard">#5697</a>)</li>
<li>Updated and clarified UI copy across Auto mode, YOLO hints, classifier notices, <code>/tokens</code>, line-number toggles, review failures, onboarding Tavily cancellation, and OpenAI subscription login labels (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5685" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5685/hovercard">#5685</a>, <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5694" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5694/hovercard">#5694</a>, <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5684" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5684/hovercard">#5684</a>, <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5687" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5687/hovercard">#5687</a>, <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5680" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5680/hovercard">#5680</a>, <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5688" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5688/hovercard">#5688</a>, <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5686" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5686/hovercard">#5686</a>, <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5691" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5691/hovercard">#5691</a>, <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5693" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5693/hovercard">#5693</a>)</li>
<li>Removed the <code>Muse Spark 1.1</code> recommendation (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5683" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5683/hovercard">#5683</a>)</li>
</ul>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto"><a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/compare/deepagents-code==0.1.57...deepagents-code==0.1.58">0.1.58</a> (2026-08-19)</h2><a id="user-content-0158-2026-08-19" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: 0.1.58 (2026-08-19)" href="#0158-2026-08-19"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Breaking Changes</h3><a id="user-content-breaking-changes" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Breaking Changes" href="#breaking-changes"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li><code>deepagents-code</code> now requires Python 3.12 or newer. (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5603" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5603/hovercard">#5603</a>)</li>
</ul>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Features</h3><a id="user-content-features-11" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Features" href="#features-11"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Added OpenRouter <code>z-ai/glm-5.3</code> to the model switcher. (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5641" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5641/hovercard">#5641</a>)</li>
<li>Added support for re-authenticating MCP servers from the viewer. (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5637" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5637/hovercard">#5637</a>)</li>
<li>Footer pickers can now be opened with <code>ctrl+click</code>. (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5611" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5611/hovercard">#5611</a>)</li>
<li>Resume hints now account for <code>TERM_PROGRAM</code> support before showing terminal-specific guidance. (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5580" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5580/hovercard">#5580</a>)</li>
</ul>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Fixes</h3><a id="user-content-fixes-1" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Fixes" href="#fixes-1"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Completed the <code>dcode config</code> command surface. (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5581" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5581/hovercard">#5581</a>)</li>
<li>Made <code>/offload</code> interruptible. (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5590" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5590/hovercard">#5590</a>)</li>
<li>Improved chat and footer UI behavior: rapid typing stays visible, double-click collapses a resized chat input, and the MCP footer wraps on narrow windows. (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5424" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5424/hovercard">#5424</a>, <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5578" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5578/hovercard">#5578</a>, <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5651" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5651/hovercard">#5651</a>)</li>
<li>Captured stdio MCP server stderr in the logger. (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5610" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5610/hovercard">#5610</a>)</li>
<li>Drained hook pipes after timeout. (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5606" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5606/hovercard">#5606</a>)</li>
<li>Grouped resume trace rounds. (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5593" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5593/hovercard">#5593</a>)</li>
<li>Omitted web-search prompt guidance when web search is unavailable. (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5602" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5602/hovercard">#5602</a>)</li>
<li>Resolved message pointer shapes per cell. (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5592" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5592/hovercard">#5592</a>)</li>
</ul>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto"><a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/compare/deepagents-code==0.1.56...deepagents-code==0.1.57">0.1.57</a> (2026-08-18)</h2><a id="user-content-0157-2026-08-18" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: 0.1.57 (2026-08-18)" href="#0157-2026-08-18"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Features</h3><a id="user-content-features-12" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Features" href="#features-12"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Added warnings before expensive cold-cache turns and trust user-declared endpoints for cold-cache policies (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5439" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5439/hovercard">#5439</a>, <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5462" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5462/hovercard">#5462</a>).</li>
<li>Made the chat input resizable by dragging its top border (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5524" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5524/hovercard">#5524</a>).</li>
<li>Added a <code>multi_select</code> question type to <code>ask_user</code> (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5097" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5097/hovercard">#5097</a>).</li>
<li>Added support for ACP approval modes (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5394" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5394/hovercard">#5394</a>).</li>
<li>Added <code>DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813</code> to the model picker (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5512" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5512/hovercard">#5512</a>).</li>
<li>Show conversation turns alongside message counts (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5571" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5571/hovercard">#5571</a>).</li>
<li>Include <code>TERM_PROGRAM</code> in the resume hint (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5548" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5548/hovercard">#5548</a>).</li>
</ul>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Bug Fixes</h3><a id="user-content-bug-fixes-10" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Bug Fixes" href="#bug-fixes-10"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Report total context after <code>/offload</code> (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5488" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5488/hovercard">#5488</a>).</li>
<li>Fixed transcript and thread restoration issues, including hydration lag, scrolling resumed threads to the bottom, and hiding empty previous-thread hints (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5479" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5479/hovercard">#5479</a>, <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5543" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5543/hovercard">#5543</a>, <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5552" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5552/hovercard">#5552</a>).</li>
<li>Fixed Auto-mode approval handling by binding “yes” to the paired <code>ask_user</code> question and avoiding duplicate Auto denial notices (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5038" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5038/hovercard">#5038</a>, <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5501" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5501/hovercard">#5501</a>).</li>
<li>Improved reload behavior by keeping the chat input responsive during <code>/reload</code>, reporting MCP server changes, and avoiding plugin reload prompt flashes or startup hints (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5529" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5529/hovercard">#5529</a>, <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5504" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5504/hovercard">#5504</a>, <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5500" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5500/hovercard">#5500</a>, <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5502" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5502/hovercard">#5502</a>).</li>
<li>Improved dependency update UI by preserving editable fields and hiding dependency details after updates (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5521" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5521/hovercard">#5521</a>, <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5519" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5519/hovercard">#5519</a>).</li>
<li>Fixed chat UI polish issues, including detached spacer mount anchors, the unfocused input cursor, and relative timestamp toggle display (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5516" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5516/hovercard">#5516</a>, <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5258" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5258/hovercard">#5258</a>, <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5503" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5503/hovercard">#5503</a>).</li>
<li>Refresh the splash version after updates (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5520" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5520/hovercard">#5520</a>).</li>
</ul>

<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Bug Fixes</h3><a id="user-content-bug-fixes-11" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Bug Fixes" href="#bug-fixes-11"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Improved dependency warning, Auto classifier, and paste expansion messages for clearer, more concise prompts and toasts (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5489" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5489/hovercard">#5489</a>, <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5446" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5446/hovercard">#5446</a>, <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5443" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5443/hovercard">#5443</a>)</li>
<li>Queued <code>/copy</code> commands while generation is active so they run at the right time (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5447" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5447/hovercard">#5447</a>)</li>
<li>Hid invalid cache metrics from the UI (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5475" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5475/hovercard">#5475</a>)</li>
<li>Fixed forced-compaction forks by preserving the <code>session_id</code> (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5492" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5492/hovercard">#5492</a>)</li>
<li>Stopped passing the removed <code>checkpoint_metadata</code> field (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5473" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5473/hovercard">#5473</a>)</li>
</ul>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto"><a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/compare/deepagents-code==0.1.54...deepagents-code==0.1.55">0.1.55</a> (2026-08-12)</h2><a id="user-content-0155-2026-08-12" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: 0.1.55 (2026-08-12)" href="#0155-2026-08-12"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Features</h3><a id="user-content-features-14" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Features" href="#features-14"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Added a <code>/context</code> usage report for inspecting context consumption (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5407" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5407/hovercard">#5407</a>).</li>
<li>Added a cache and context status row for at-a-glance session state (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5408" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5408/hovercard">#5408</a>).</li>
<li>Added configurable warnings when a session exceeds the configured cost threshold (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5405" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5405/hovercard">#5405</a>).</li>
<li>Added support for persisting and reconfiguring ACP sessions (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5366" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5366/hovercard">#5366</a>).</li>
<li>Added automatic updates for installed plugins (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5368" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5368/hovercard">#5368</a>).</li>
<li>Added a toggle for diff line numbers (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5427" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5427/hovercard">#5427</a>).</li>
<li><code>Ctrl+S</code> in <code>/auto model</code> now stores <code>[models].auto_classifier</code> (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5313" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5313/hovercard">#5313</a>).</li>
</ul>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Fixes</h3><a id="user-content-fixes-2" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Fixes" href="#fixes-2"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Restored edit diffs in resumed threads (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5391" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5391/hovercard">#5391</a>).</li>
<li>Added a resume hint after crashes (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5412" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5412/hovercard">#5412</a>).</li>
<li>Clarified the project hooks trust prompt and stopped prompting for user hooks (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5426" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5426/hovercard">#5426</a>).</li>
<li>Cleared dynamic subagents on the next turn (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5437" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5437/hovercard">#5437</a>).</li>
<li>Improved grouped tool summaries by counting distinct targets (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5409" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5409/hovercard">#5409</a>).</li>
<li>Improved ask-user choice wrapping and selection styling (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5442" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5442/hovercard">#5442</a>).</li>
<li>Serialized <code>dcode</code> self-upgrades across processes (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5252" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5252/hovercard">#5252</a>).</li>
<li>Added warnings for stale dependencies in editable installs (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5386" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5386/hovercard">#5386</a>).</li>
<li>Hid incomplete extras from version output (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5352" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5352/hovercard">#5352</a>).</li>
<li>Removed the optional-provider startup tip (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5421" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5421/hovercard">#5421</a>).</li>
<li>Removed the “Message restored to input” toast (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5253" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5253/hovercard">#5253</a>).</li>
</ul>

<ul dir="auto">
<li>Added pricing coverage with Baseten built-in overrides and local fallback overrides when <code>genai-prices</code> is missing data (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5312" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5312/hovercard">#5312</a>, <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5304" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5304/hovercard">#5304</a>).</li>
