<li>Added terminal program trace metadata (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5329" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5329/hovercard">#5329</a>).</li>
</ul>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Bug Fixes</h3><a id="user-content-bug-fixes-13" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Bug Fixes" href="#bug-fixes-13"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Preserved runtime offload archive routing (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5328" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5328/hovercard">#5328</a>).</li>
<li>Always restart after a successful startup auto-update (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5317" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5317/hovercard">#5317</a>).</li>
<li>Fixed leaked turn coroutines and SQLite handles (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5218" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5218/hovercard">#5218</a>).</li>
<li>Keep MCP shutdown-race tracebacks from appearing in the terminal (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5325" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5325/hovercard">#5325</a>).</li>
<li>Open the <code>/auto model</code> selector immediately while connecting (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5341" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5341/hovercard">#5341</a>).</li>
<li>Route failures to <code>PostToolUseFailure</code> (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5315" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5315/hovercard">#5315</a>).</li>
<li>Use dismissed copy for ask-user prompts (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5331" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5331/hovercard">#5331</a>).</li>
</ul>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto"><a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/compare/deepagents-code==0.1.51...deepagents-code==0.1.52">0.1.52</a> (2026-08-04)</h2><a id="user-content-0152-2026-08-04" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: 0.1.52 (2026-08-04)" href="#0152-2026-08-04"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Features</h3><a id="user-content-features-17" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Features" href="#features-17"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Hooks v2 is now generally available, with support for loading hooks from installed plugins. (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5307" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5307/hovercard">#5307</a>, <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5198" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5198/hovercard">#5198</a>)</li>
<li>Auto approval classifier configuration now supports selecting the classifier model and setting a review timeout. (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5205" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5205/hovercard">#5205</a>, <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5302" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5302/hovercard">#5302</a>)</li>
<li>HITL rejection reasons are now framed for the model, and the approval menu makes reject-with-feedback easier to discover. (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5259" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5259/hovercard">#5259</a>, <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5260" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5260/hovercard">#5260</a>)</li>
<li>Added a tri-state <code>DEEPAGENTS_CODE_ONBOARDING</code> environment variable. (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5301" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5301/hovercard">#5301</a>)</li>
<li>The <code>/model</code> footer Ctrl+N hint now follows the current display mode. (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5247" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5247/hovercard">#5247</a>)</li>
<li>The price catalog now refreshes hourly in the background. (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5264" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5264/hovercard">#5264</a>)</li>
<li>Updated recommendations to include DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731. (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5244" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5244/hovercard">#5244</a>)</li>
</ul>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Bug Fixes</h3><a id="user-content-bug-fixes-14" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Bug Fixes" href="#bug-fixes-14"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Fixed several Hooks v2 lifecycle issues: session-end teardown is now bounded, hooks refresh after cwd switches, malformed hook resumes are handled, hook stops surface without agent errors, and unused <code>SessionEndCause</code> members were removed. (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5248" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5248/hovercard">#5248</a>, <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5249" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5249/hovercard">#5249</a>, <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5233" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5233/hovercard">#5233</a>, <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5276" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5276/hovercard">#5276</a>, <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5240" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5240/hovercard">#5240</a>)</li>
<li><code>PreCompact</code> now fires before auto-compaction. (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5277" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5277/hovercard">#5277</a>)</li>
</ul>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto"><a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/compare/deepagents-code==0.1.50...deepagents-code==0.1.51">0.1.51</a> (2026-07-31)</h2><a id="user-content-0151-2026-07-31" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: 0.1.51 (2026-07-31)" href="#0151-2026-07-31"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Features</h3><a id="user-content-features-18" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Features" href="#features-18"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>The status bar and usage view now show the running session cost. (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5036" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5036/hovercard">#5036</a>)</li>
<li>Removed redundant <code>shell</code> and <code>web_search</code> prompt guidance. (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5213" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5213/hovercard">#5213</a>)</li>
<li>After switching threads, Deep Agents now points back to the previous thread. (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5172" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5172/hovercard">#5172</a>)</li>
<li>Leaving <code>/mcp</code> with pending toggles now prompts you to reconnect. (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5211" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5211/hovercard">#5211</a>)</li>
<li><code>dcode config get</code> now accepts configuration sections. (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5134" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5134/hovercard">#5134</a>)</li>
</ul>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Fixes</h3><a id="user-content-fixes-3" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Fixes" href="#fixes-3"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Kept the <code>/goal</code> criteria prompt responsive. (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5142" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5142/hovercard">#5142</a>)</li>
<li>Improved goal handling so underspecified objectives can be resolved from conversation context. (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5201" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5201/hovercard">#5201</a>)</li>
<li>Released the turn when an interrupted worker never starts. (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5196" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5196/hovercard">#5196</a>)</li>
<li>Hid timestamp footers together with their associated rows. (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5167" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5167/hovercard">#5167</a>)</li>
<li>Fixed editable SDK detection by scanning and correlating SDK locations more accurately. (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5199" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5199/hovercard">#5199</a>)</li>
<li>Improved <code>doctor</code> output to explain why it may not have a latest-version answer. (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5209" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5209/hovercard">#5209</a>)</li>
</ul>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto"><a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/compare/deepagents-code==0.1.49...deepagents-code==0.1.50">0.1.50</a> (2026-07-30)</h2><a id="user-content-0150-2026-07-30" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: 0.1.50 (2026-07-30)" href="#0150-2026-07-30"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Highlights</h3><a id="user-content-highlights" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Highlights" href="#highlights"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Added project hooks workspace trust and expanded Hooks v2 support with client and server lifecycle events plus runtime feedback (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5105" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5105/hovercard">#5105</a>, <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5104" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5104/hovercard">#5104</a>, <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4997" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4997/hovercard">#4997</a>, <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5045" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5045/hovercard">#5045</a>).</li>
<li>Added an option to mute the “YOLO is active” toast (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5103" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5103/hovercard">#5103</a>).</li>
<li>Made the splash screen <code>thread</code> ID clickable to copy it (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5173" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5173/hovercard">#5173</a>).</li>
<li>Show <code>ask_user</code> answers directly on the answered tool row (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5100" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5100/hovercard">#5100</a>).</li>
<li>Show a toast when submitting an empty required <code>ask_user</code> answer (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5095" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5095/hovercard">#5095</a>).</li>
<li>Added thread message counts to the Debug Console (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5117" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5117/hovercard">#5117</a>).</li>
</ul>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Fixes and improvements</h3><a id="user-content-fixes-and-improvements" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Fixes and improvements" href="#fixes-and-improvements"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Gated Hooks v2 behind <code>DEEPAGENTS_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL</code> and improved hook resume stability across identity and Command tool results (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5146" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5146/hovercard">#5146</a>, <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5176" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5176/hovercard">#5176</a>).</li>
<li>Kept server hook state out of task results (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5164" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5164/hovercard">#5164</a>).</li>
<li>Stopped duplicate Auto transcript events during interrupt replay (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5157" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5157/hovercard">#5157</a>).</li>
<li>Kept <code>/update</code> and <code>/install --package</code> prompts responsive (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5127" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5127/hovercard">#5127</a>).</li>
<li>Refreshed the <code>/threads</code> cache after each turn (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5174" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5174/hovercard">#5174</a>).</li>
<li>Anchored toasts above the chat input and added a toast when media is dropped into a free-text question (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5101" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5101/hovercard">#5101</a>, <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5099" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5099/hovercard">#5099</a>).</li>
<li>Improved thread status message styling and links (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5118" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5118/hovercard">#5118</a>).</li>
<li>Made resume hints echo the launched command name (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5119" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5119/hovercard">#5119</a>).</li>
<li>Scoped selection copy to the clicked screen (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5140" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5140/hovercard">#5140</a>).</li>
<li>Ignored mouse hits on detached widgets (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5114" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5114/hovercard">#5114</a>).</li>
</ul>

<ul dir="auto">
<li>Auto mode is now generally available. <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4957" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4957/hovercard">#4957</a></li>
<li>Added configurable Auto goal-criteria acceptance. <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4940" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4940/hovercard">#4940</a></li>
<li>Improved Auto behavior by authorizing actions from active goal/rubric directives, avoiding redundant approval prompts, showing the enable notice only on first global enable, deduplicating classifier-unavailable transcript spam, logging underlying classifier failures, and reporting classifier timeout budgets. <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5017" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5017/hovercard">#5017</a> <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4993" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4993/hovercard">#4993</a> <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5012" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5012/hovercard">#5012</a> <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5013" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5013/hovercard">#5013</a> <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5011" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5011/hovercard">#5011</a> <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5025" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5025/hovercard">#5025</a></li>
<li>Added Hooks v2 capability snapshots and session transcripts, and hardened Hooks v2 command execution. <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4916" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4916/hovercard">#4916</a> <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4918" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4918/hovercard">#4918</a> <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4917" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4917/hovercard">#4917</a></li>
<li>Raised the agent recursion limit to 2000 and made it configurable. <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4994" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4994/hovercard">#4994</a></li>
</ul>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Improvements and fixes</h3><a id="user-content-improvements-and-fixes" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Improvements and fixes" href="#improvements-and-fixes"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Let the rubric grader inspect working-directory files, show rubric grader defaults, and improved <code>/rubric</code> help and empty-state messaging. <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4835" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4835/hovercard">#4835</a> <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4966" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4966/hovercard">#4966</a> <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5015" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5015/hovercard">#5015</a></li>
<li>Unified goal activation signaling. <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4980" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4980/hovercard">#4980</a></li>
<li>Made Version, Model, and CWD copyable in the Debug Console. <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4975" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4975/hovercard">#4975</a></li>
<li>Improved <code>config get</code> output when a key is missing. <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4976" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4976/hovercard">#4976</a></li>
<li>Aborted YOLO launch on <code>Ctrl+C</code>/<code>Ctrl+D</code> and made the YOLO warning friendlier for new users. <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4953" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4953/hovercard">#4953</a> <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4950" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4950/hovercard">#4950</a></li>
<li>Updated LangSmith handling: secret redaction is disabled by default, <code>/trace</code> now flags empty env overrides that shadow the LangSmith key, and the default US endpoint is no longer treated as a custom target. <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4970" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4970/hovercard">#4970</a> <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4996" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4996/hovercard">#4996</a> <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5022" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5022/hovercard">#5022</a></li>
<li>Injected OpenAI <code>prompt_cache_key</code> for any OpenAI-provider endpoint. <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4995" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4995/hovercard">#4995</a></li>
<li>Improved tool and schema presentation: finished calls stay on the live tool-group line, first-party tool schemas now include field descriptions, and <code>web_search</code>/<code>fetch_url</code> tool descriptions were trimmed. <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4927" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4927/hovercard">#4927</a> <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5019" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5019/hovercard">#5019</a> <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/5016" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/5016/hovercard">#5016</a></li>
<li>Omitted <code>plugins/</code> and <code>conversation_history/</code> from the <code>/agent</code> picker. <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4991" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4991/hovercard">#4991</a></li>
<li>Made selector modal backdrop dimming consistent. <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4990" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4990/hovercard">#4990</a></li>
<li>Restored the <code>"Server log preserved at:"</code> notice on exit. <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4999" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4999/hovercard">#4999</a></li>
<li>Used the SDK pin as the effective editable version. <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4949" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4949/hovercard">#4949</a></li>
</ul>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto"><a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/compare/deepagents-code==0.1.44...deepagents-code==0.1.45">0.1.45</a> (2026-07-22)</h2><a id="user-content-0145-2026-07-22" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: 0.1.45 (2026-07-22)" href="#0145-2026-07-22"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Features</h3><a id="user-content-features-22" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Features" href="#features-22"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Added the Hooks v2 execution engine and typed hooks data models (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4880" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4880/hovercard">#4880</a>, <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4870" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4870/hovercard">#4870</a>)</li>
<li>Added a filesystem tool allowlist for <code>dcode</code> with <code>--allow-fs-tools</code> (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4635" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4635/hovercard">#4635</a>)</li>
<li>Added a GLM-5.2 harness profile (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4710" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4710/hovercard">#4710</a>)</li>
<li>Added a built-in thread inspector skill (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4769" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4769/hovercard">#4769</a>)</li>
<li>Replaced Gemini 3.5 Flash with Gemini 3.6 Flash in the model switcher (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4890" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4890/hovercard">#4890</a>)</li>
<li>Show experimental mode in the splash screen and debug console (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4863" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4863/hovercard">#4863</a>)</li>
<li>Gate debug console click-to-copy behind a checkbox (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4810" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4810/hovercard">#4810</a>)</li>
</ul>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Bug Fixes</h3><a id="user-content-bug-fixes-17" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Bug Fixes" href="#bug-fixes-17"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Improved scratch-file handling by allowing cleanup of agent-created scratch files and safe OS-temp scratch artifacts (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4860" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4860/hovercard">#4860</a>, <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4869" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4869/hovercard">#4869</a>)</li>
<li>Skip grading during <code>/goal</code> proposals (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4941" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4941/hovercard">#4941</a>)</li>
<li>Improved MCP approval handling: Esc now aborts project MCP approval, disabled MCP servers are honored for plugins, remembered approvals are preserved with the env allowlist, and approvals are shared across Git worktrees (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4888" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4888/hovercard">#4888</a>, <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4848" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4848/hovercard">#4848</a>, <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4889" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4889/hovercard">#4889</a>, <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4939" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4939/hovercard">#4939</a>)</li>
<li>Hardened installer downloads and paths (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4871" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4871/hovercard">#4871</a>)</li>
<li>Fixed forced <code>dcode update</code> checks to bust the CDN cache (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4862" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4862/hovercard">#4862</a>)</li>
<li>Prevented failed exit setup from stranding the app (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4913" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4913/hovercard">#4913</a>)</li>
<li>Fixed routing so <code>ctrl+x</code> goes to the focused <code>ask_user</code> input (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4926" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4926/hovercard">#4926</a>)</li>
<li>Show <code>-m</code> prompts as queued immediately on startup (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4861" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4861/hovercard">#4861</a>)</li>
<li>Kept harness-profile diagnostics out of terminal output (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4943" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4943/hovercard">#4943</a>)</li>
<li>Avoid tracking inline restart callers (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4894" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4894/hovercard">#4894</a>)</li>
<li>Fixed debug console thread ID copying on click (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4945" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4945/hovercard">#4945</a>)</li>
</ul>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Performance Improvements</h3><a id="user-content-performance-improvements-2" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Performance Improvements" href="#performance-improvements-2"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Reduced exit latency by coordinating async shutdown teardown (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4831" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4831/hovercard">#4831</a>)</li>
<li>Sped up local context detection (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4922" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4922/hovercard">#4922</a>)</li>
</ul>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto"><a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/compare/deepagents-code==0.1.43...deepagents-code==0.1.44">0.1.44</a> (2026-07-20)</h2><a id="user-content-0144-2026-07-20" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: 0.1.44 (2026-07-20)" href="#0144-2026-07-20"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Bug Fixes</h3><a id="user-content-bug-fixes-18" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Bug Fixes" href="#bug-fixes-18"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Improved approval handling by hiding the <code>Auto</code> option when it isn't eligible and moving Auto mode path checks off the event loop. (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4839" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4839/hovercard">#4839</a>, <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4856" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4856/hovercard">#4856</a>)</li>
<li>Warmed MCP auth imports off the event loop to avoid blocking runtime work. (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4855" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4855/hovercard">#4855</a>)</li>
</ul>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto"><a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/compare/deepagents-code==0.1.42...deepagents-code==0.1.43">0.1.43</a> (2026-07-17)</h2><a id="user-content-0143-2026-07-17" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: 0.1.43 (2026-07-17)" href="#0143-2026-07-17"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Features</h3><a id="user-content-features-23" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Features" href="#features-23"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Added classifier-backed Auto approval mode behind <code>DEEPAGENTS_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL=1</code> (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4804" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4804/hovercard">#4804</a>).</li>
<li>Added a shutdown toast for deferred exits (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4830" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4830/hovercard">#4830</a>).</li>
<li>Task descriptions that were truncated can now be expanded by clicking or pressing <code>Ctrl+O</code> (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4811" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4811/hovercard">#4811</a>).</li>
<li>Debug Console clears with <code>Ctrl+L</code> now persist after reopening (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4812" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4812/hovercard">#4812</a>).</li>
<li>Added debug logging for skill-name override collisions (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4772" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4772/hovercard">#4772</a>).</li>
</ul>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Bug Fixes</h3><a id="user-content-bug-fixes-19" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Bug Fixes" href="#bug-fixes-19"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Keep chat input responsive during <code>/restart</code> (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4808" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4808/hovercard">#4808</a>).</li>
<li>Fixed paste placeholders disappearing when backspacing a newline below them (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4757" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4757/hovercard">#4757</a>).</li>
<li>Made markdown <code>AppMessage</code> output selectable (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4814" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4814/hovercard">#4814</a>).</li>
<li>Fixed live tool-group counts to include only running tools (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4809" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4809/hovercard">#4809</a>).</li>
<li>Kept <code>task</code> timers monotonic across nested subagent human-in-the-loop flows (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4771" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4771/hovercard">#4771</a>).</li>
<li>Preserved goal criteria proposals when marker clearing fails (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4785" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4785/hovercard">#4785</a>).</li>
<li>Reduced repeated probing of an unreachable Ollama daemon to once per reload (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4806" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4806/hovercard">#4806</a>).</li>
<li>Quieted MCP auth-skip debug logging for known patterns (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4805" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4805/hovercard">#4805</a>).</li>
<li>Improved <code>/version</code> diagnostics for editable installs and core dependency reporting, including surfacing <code>langchain-quickjs</code> (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4816" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4816/hovercard">#4816</a>, <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4813" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4813/hovercard">#4813</a>).</li>
<li>Removed the <code>uv install</code> tip from the <code>/version</code> update hint (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4822" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4822/hovercard">#4822</a>).</li>
</ul>

<ul dir="auto">
<li>Plugins are now generally available. (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4797" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4797/hovercard">#4797</a>)</li>
<li>Added search to the plugin list and now summarize plugin changes after reloads. (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4765" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4765/hovercard">#4765</a>, <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4767" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4767/hovercard">#4767</a>)</li>
<li>Added Kimi K3 to the OpenRouter model selector. (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4803" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4803/hovercard">#4803</a>)</li>
<li>Added hidden <code>connect</code> and <code>reconnect</code> keywords for <code>/restart</code>. (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4807" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4807/hovercard">#4807</a>)</li>
<li>Debug Console thread IDs can now be clicked to copy, with an added LangSmith link. (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4760" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4760/hovercard">#4760</a>)</li>
<li>Added auto-approve (YOLO) mode to trace metadata. (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4764" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4764/hovercard">#4764</a>)</li>
</ul>

<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Features</h3><a id="user-content-features-25" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Features" href="#features-25"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Added plugin marketplace support (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4554" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4554/hovercard">#4554</a>).</li>
<li>Added an “always allow” option to the project MCP approval prompt (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4562" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4562/hovercard">#4562</a>).</li>
<li>Improved <code>/goal</code> workflows: criteria generation now runs server-side, YOLO mode auto-accepts criteria, goals complete after satisfied grading, and goal review editing now supports <code>Ctrl+X</code> (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4754" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4754/hovercard">#4754</a>, <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4784" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4784/hovercard">#4784</a>, <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4781" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4781/hovercard">#4781</a>, <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4780" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4780/hovercard">#4780</a>).</li>
<li>Reasoning effort now persists across restarts (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4728" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4728/hovercard">#4728</a>).</li>
<li>Added a toast prompting you to re-paste when a chat paste collapses (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4742" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4742/hovercard">#4742</a>).</li>
</ul>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Bug Fixes</h3><a id="user-content-bug-fixes-22" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Bug Fixes" href="#bug-fixes-22"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Tool calls awaiting approval are now surfaced correctly (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4739" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4739/hovercard">#4739</a>).</li>
<li>Fixed transcript tail hydration when scrolled to the bottom edge (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4733" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4733/hovercard">#4733</a>).</li>
<li>Kept chat input responsive during MCP viewer <code>Ctrl+R</code> reconnects (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4753" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4753/hovercard">#4753</a>).</li>
<li>Improved inline free-text prompts by sharing paste handling and matching primary-input <code>Ctrl+D</code> behavior (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4736" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4736/hovercard">#4736</a>, <a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4729" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4729/hovercard">#4729</a>).</li>
<li>Fixed local offloaded tool results to use the real filesystem (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4740" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4740/hovercard">#4740</a>).</li>
<li>Cleaned offloaded history when deleting a thread (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4751" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4751/hovercard">#4751</a>).</li>
<li>Removed duplicated content from the system prompt by overwriting the base prompt (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4516" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4516/hovercard">#4516</a>).</li>
<li>Closed subprocess transport during install teardown (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4735" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4735/hovercard">#4735</a>).</li>
<li>Added targeted <code>uv</code> constraints for prerelease dependencies (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/4744" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/langchain-ai/deepagents/pull/4744/hovercard">#4744</a>).</li>
</ul>

<ul dir="auto">
<li>Make auto-update opt-out by default (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/3994">#3994</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/commit/7ff6e2224d7ba8462c073333da937c35831f9b34">7ff6e22</a>)</li>
<li>Warn on <code>--interpreter-tools</code> without <code>--interpreter</code> (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/3976">#3976</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/commit/e68e720e2c3caa4e4e7c5e937faf718db7ad2e98">e68e720</a>)</li>
<li>Add pre-release update support (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/3960">#3960</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/commit/341a5cc55a30d808dbb366b396923c7801c431d2">341a5cc</a>)</li>
<li>Add agent filter dropdown to <code>/threads</code> picker (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/3677">#3677</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/commit/f8193df41d7c47626d94252039217f4079d117cd">f8193df</a>)</li>
<li>Non-interactive <code>deepagents auth</code> subcommands (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/3910">#3910</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/commit/11a71bbf00c4e6c1f989e70fb3472a65c8d39662">11a71bb</a>)</li>
<li>Prompt before updating an out-of-date dcode install (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/3995">#3995</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/commit/a5ec6dd0fec66ad321c1cc0f5e2f990c9026e03f">a5ec6dd</a>)</li>
</ul>

<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Bug Fixes</h3><a id="user-content-bug-fixes-46" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Bug Fixes" href="#bug-fixes-46"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Add debug-log guidance for truncated startup errors (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/3849">#3849</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/commit/cd1ef303cf5d0e9d746c787eb09a4a89437e965a">cd1ef30</a>)</li>
<li>Drop lock-key events so Caps Lock in iTerm2 doesn't type (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/3855">#3855</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/commit/110f1a7a975743efda12e181cb3afc8404202254">110f1a7</a>)</li>
<li>Hand pointer over splash tracing project link (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/3858">#3858</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/commit/ea7dae58a37cfb1d2b96544eb7c941aad331b280">ea7dae5</a>)</li>
<li>Keep terminal-default theme on Esc in <code>/theme</code> selector (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/3854">#3854</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/commit/c3bc67b0cdeda6f4dbcc6360ddd72b455aec4fe7">c3bc67b</a>)</li>
<li>Preserve inherited <code>PYTHONPATH</code> for server subprocess (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/3833">#3833</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/commit/4689569f94138987319cd9cbb45ce66a1f496934">4689569</a>)</li>
<li>Resolve interpreter PTC allowlist against the runtime tool registry (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/3845">#3845</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/commit/c59a27ef2405b8e04c4351ce7ffa53d8d16d519c">c59a27e</a>)</li>
<li>Treat multi-line key-event pastes as one input (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/3856">#3856</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/commit/6bb15d4bd97bd16f47504f937c8458d1b53d9cc4">6bb15d4</a>)</li>
</ul>

<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Features</h3><a id="user-content-features-49" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Features" href="#features-49"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Add <code>get_current_thread_id</code> tool (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/3820">#3820</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/commit/18ce094b7036796c7e23ce1338f4da56dc2ef126">18ce094</a>)</li>
<li>Guard managed onboarding-name memory block from edits (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/3822">#3822</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/commit/dc0a51fc81d01b62dc8043148a9fd87099fc9123">dc0a51f</a>)</li>
<li>Offer restart after restart-capable install (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/3821">#3821</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/commit/e356efeff1c8bfb894119cebbb7d3c0853d327a2">e356efe</a>)</li>
<li>Persist <code>/threads</code> directory-scope preference (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/3824">#3824</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/commit/51a29f4a0c28c122acae296a0df03bee20474455">51a29f4</a>)</li>
<li>Surface gateway key mismatch on <code>PermissionDeniedError</code> (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/3813">#3813</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/commit/5bd1ef8cb29db781ccbb37755db44ce0ab1d7bd2">5bd1ef8</a>)</li>
</ul>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Bug Fixes</h3><a id="user-content-bug-fixes-47" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Bug Fixes" href="#bug-fixes-47"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Surface cached MCP errors as failed tool messages (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/3829">#3829</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/commit/d83b428f7f97bc40b9219c02846c2d8b4ccac434">d83b428</a>)</li>
<li>Handle MCP tool errors locally (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/3830">#3830</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/commit/97a7052b3eef7ec80bc90a4c3b606deeaf13cb9b">97a7052</a>)</li>
<li>Make non-incognito <code>!</code> shell output visible to the model (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/3825">#3825</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/commit/2407bca66bac5d199a923a0e58872c813eb006bc">2407bca</a>)</li>
<li>Expose <code>/restart</code> slash command (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/3809">#3809</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/commit/64505b848868b80213b6da87113cd63890c3d520">64505b8</a>)</li>
<li>Agent retries <code>gh search</code> with invalid <code>mergedAt</code> field (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/3802">#3802</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/commit/0b683a9435b95bce79d10451868eae54c6a3e88c">0b683a9</a>)</li>
<li>Clarify <code>/restart</code> message during server startup (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/3823">#3823</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/commit/49ded9ef448dcd263bee07ac15f4904dd342bfa2">49ded9e</a>)</li>
<li>Cursor at end when popping queued message to input (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/3832">#3832</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/commit/aa522c94fffb93dc578addb39b4879f779ac5899">aa522c9</a>)</li>
<li>Coalesce streamed markdown writes to keep input responsive (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/3819">#3819</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/commit/b45eeebaf7e6ae6e07b8f9ca521525c66fe14f63">b45eeeb</a>)</li>
<li>Don't show <code>"No threads found"</code> while threads load (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/3815">#3815</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/commit/68e64263f590b3244b689664715f354fb3a389cd">68e6426</a>)</li>
<li>Ignore stale cwd warmers in file autocomplete cache (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/3835">#3835</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/commit/9c8c2b24853b7b3a7610cbcfc368a6464c0711e0">9c8c2b2</a>)</li>
<li>Offer cwd switch on resume (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/3810">#3810</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/commit/d417f530aafa8c77523487393dc3039cc822dc09">d417f53</a>)</li>
<li>Recover from tool errors instead of aborting run (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/3804">#3804</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/commit/45691c556105e171c7210c7c10388dc73202a025">45691c5</a>)</li>
<li>Show <code>/restart</code> feedback (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/3808">#3808</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/commit/c40bef9b2aaace3909593503b28e8b548bc20014">c40bef9</a>)</li>
<li>Standardize search previews and restart status (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/3806">#3806</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/commit/71a6d508b21b275c0c7c6bd2e0752adfba496ea9">71a6d50</a>)</li>
<li>Suppress stale update notices (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/3801">#3801</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/commit/db252411d8ca945aca86429acb644540ec970bdb">db25241</a>)</li>
<li>Unblock <code>/remember</code> in server mode (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/3812">#3812</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/commit/12e00e1a78e2d6be106147a0aa95a518be66849f">12e00e1</a>)</li>
<li>Unblock TUI input during <code>/restart</code> (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/3826">#3826</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/commit/366cd81269e2d3891a477848b774cf51af0cefc0">366cd81</a>)</li>

<ul dir="auto">
<li>Fix zero tool MCP server rendering (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/3649">#3649</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/commit/7e7a567556110ad927a78b45c3a3d4ac37b65e86">7e7a567</a>)</li>
<li>Centralize debug logging setup to package root (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/3650">#3650</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/commit/5145ed1f8296f41d78c905c2ce899d2742f7dc9b">5145ed1</a>)</li>
<li>Char-truncate execute tool preview output (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/3627">#3627</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/commit/bb276e2c41177b0dfe6ffd44fd37a293fbfdcb27">bb276e2</a>)</li>
<li>Handle stale slash-command <code>Enter</code> before completion popup renders (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/3647">#3647</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/commit/9a287424e86d5d52d0a328388c3fe453b160f597">9a28742</a>)</li>
<li>Keep chat input focused when clicking a message (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/3655">#3655</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/commit/daf65716d7c999eadb2b7c37e412ec07b2c7aed3">daf6571</a>)</li>
<li>Mention <code>Ctrl+R</code> in MCP reconnect toast (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/3622">#3622</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/commit/3b4b0867665e58959073e660d85b74c700acaa1e">3b4b086</a>)</li>
<li>Prevent duplicate-id crash on MCP reconnect and clipboard <code>NoScreen</code> (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/3632">#3632</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/commit/6b9a3c051586c26c542e958849e952d08a4b5a88">6b9a3c0</a>)</li>
<li>Reconstruct message counts for <code>DeltaChannel</code> threads from writes table (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/3668">#3668</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/commit/27e1940a924abfc999126cf46024003f453ba0c8">27e1940</a>)</li>
<li>Render MCP tool errors and drop empty-string optional params (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/3624">#3624</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/commit/fdf3db464cd9f3de4e84c246547dd2971d26c726">fdf3db4</a>)</li>
<li>Respect line width in tool output previews (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/3646">#3646</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/commit/ba1ad2dbabd19b3821490537465a3bcd39c6fed6">ba1ad2d</a>)</li>
<li>Restore resumed thread model (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/3651">#3651</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/commit/550a8abf3c595d738162a97f694b5d9527613323">550a8ab</a>)</li>
<li>Tool spinner, result formatting, and expand-hint fixes (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/3661">#3661</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/commit/54485a305854f46a6ce00ae4df51f3301c652a38">54485a3</a>)</li>
</ul>
